name: validate_project
description: Validate a Project YAML file in the workspace against the Project schema and the Core rules. Returns status 'ok' with no diagnostics, or status 'rejected' with typed diagnostics (code, sourceRef, message). A rejected plan is a normal result, not a tool error. A dependency cycle is rejected here, naming the objects on it. This tool computes no dates, so a fixed date that contradicts its dependencies is found only by schedule_project: run it to read dates.

project.description: A '/'-separated path relative to the workspace root. No drive, no leading '/', no '..', no backslash or colon. The file must already exist inside the workspace.

name: schedule_project
description: Compute the schedule of a Project YAML file in the workspace. On 'ok' returns placements per object id ({start, end} or {at}, ISO dates, end exclusive) and the analysis (critical object ids on zero-float driving paths to project finish; totalFloat records {value, unit, calendar}, with calendar-days/null or working-days/effective object calendar id, including Project fallback). A fixed date that contradicts its dependencies, or a bound that cannot be met, is rejected here and not by validate_project (a dependency cycle is rejected by both). 'warnings' lists W_DEADLINE for each object planned to finish after its deadline (the plan is still scheduled; the deadline is a promise, not a bound). Read dates from this result; never compute a date by hand.

project.description: A '/'-separated path relative to the workspace root. No drive, no leading '/', no '..', no backslash or colon. The file must already exist inside the workspace.

name: render_draft
description: Render a Project YAML file in the workspace to a deterministic draft picture. By default the result carries a PNG preview image (inline 'image'); inline 'svg' carries the SVG text; 'none' carries only the structured result. 'format' chooses the artifact that contentIdentity and byteLength describe. 'preset' is a builtin id from list_presets or a workspace .yaml path; omitted means chrona-default-draft. The tool writes no file, and it renders the file you name, not a saved Render Context. PNG needs the render extra (pngAvailable says whether it is installed). Read 'status' and 'warnings', not only isError: a rejected plan is a result, and a warning means something was clipped, suppressed or substituted.

project.description: A '/'-separated path relative to the workspace root. No drive, no leading '/', no '..', no backslash or colon. The file must already exist inside the workspace.

name: render_review
description: Render an immutable Render Context from a Store: the same render as chrona render-review with --store-config, not a draft. 'contextReference' is a workspace path to the Context's resource reference; 'storeConfig' is a workspace path to the Store configuration (default .chrona/store.yaml) and every Store root in it must lie inside the workspace. The Context fixes its own format and viewport, so none is an argument. Every reference is verified against its pinned contentIdentity, and the Store's integrity setting applies; no argument lowers it. Returns the target 'format', the artifact's contentIdentity and byteLength, 'warnings', and with inline 'artifact' the SVG text or PNG image. The tool is read-only, works without --allow-write, and writes no file.

contextReference.description: A '/'-separated workspace path to the immutable Render Context to render, as chrona render-review --context-reference takes: a YAML resource reference (id, kind, store, address, revision, contentIdentity). The file must already exist inside the workspace.

inline.description: 'artifact' carries an SVG target as SVG text and a PNG target as an image; any other target, or 'none', carries only the structured result.

name: compare_baseline
description: Compare a named baseline (a snapshot-ref) with a candidate Project in a Store: the same comparison as chrona baseline-compare. Both references are workspace paths; 'storeConfig' is a workspace path to the Store configuration (default .chrona/store.yaml) and every Store root in it must lie inside the workspace. Both closures are verified against their pinned contentIdentity; no argument lowers the Store's integrity. Returns status 'ok' with automationResult (the Automation Result the command line writes: the changed objects and both schedules), or 'rejected' with typed diagnostics. The tool is read-only, works without --allow-write, and writes no file.

name: check_command
description: Check an inline Command Request object (version: chrona/command/v0.3 or version: chrona/command/v0.4), or a contained command-file path, against its Store without writing anything: the same check as chrona command-check. The request must be applyActualIntakeBatch (an Actual intake batch), captureSnapshot (a named baseline), revertActualCommand or redoActualCommand; any other type is rejected with E_AUTOMATION_OPERATION_UNSUPPORTED. 'storeConfig' is a workspace path to a Store configuration and defaults to .chrona/store.yaml; every Store root in it must lie inside the workspace. Returns status 'ok' with automationResult (the Automation Result the command line writes), or 'rejected' with typed diagnostics, for example a stale baseRevision. A preview is not a precondition of apply_command, and it works whether or not writes are enabled.

name: apply_command
description: Apply an inline Command Request object (version: chrona/command/v0.3 or version: chrona/command/v0.4), or a contained command-file path, to its Store: the same work as chrona command-apply. It executes directly. There is no approval step and no confirm token, and the proposal and decision exchange of Spec 10 section 9.1 is not implemented. It writes only when the server was started with --allow-write; otherwise it is refused with E_MCP_WRITE_DISABLED and writes nothing. The request must be applyActualIntakeBatch, captureSnapshot, revertActualCommand or redoActualCommand. Safeguards that are not approvals: a stale baseRevision is rejected (compare-and-set), the same commandId with the same request is a no-op that returns the first result (replayed: true), a baseline name or an observation with different facts is never overwritten, and every write is a new immutable Store revision, so an earlier one can be inspected and restored. Store roots must lie inside the workspace. Returns status 'ok' with automationResult, or 'rejected' with typed diagnostics.

name: apply_authoring_command
description: Apply an inline request with version: chrona/authoring-command/v0.1 or a contained YAML command file to a guided workspace. For workspace: guided/workspace.yaml, use target {kind: authoring-workspace, path: workspace.yaml}; target.path is only the selected workspace's file name, not its outer path. A request has version, commandId, type, target, baseRevision and payload. Types/payloads: setWorkspaceTask {task:{id,title,planned:{start,finish}}}; setWorkspaceActual {actual:{taskId,actual:{start,finish},progress?}}; selectPresentationPreset {preset:{id,version,path}}; setPresentationOverride {overrides:{view?,theme?}}; materializePresentationPreset {directory?}. Get baseRevision from create_workspace/workspace_revision or the last authoringResult.resultRevision. Inverse edits revert source changes at a new revision. All paths stay inside the server workspace. Requires --allow-write; no approval step. A stale baseRevision is rejected without writing. A durable receipt returns the exact first accepted result for the same commandId and request; reusing that ID with another request is rejected. Returns authoringResult, with status ok when accepted or rejected with typed diagnostics.

workspace.description: A '/'-separated path relative to the workspace root. No drive, no leading '/', no '..', no backslash or colon. The file must already exist inside the workspace.

command.description: Inline request with version: chrona/authoring-command/v0.1, or a contained command-file path. name: create_workspace
description: Create a new directory containing workspace.yaml and a local preset/ copy. Requires --allow-write. directory must not exist; its real parent must exist below the server workspace. No overwrite. project is {id,title?,tasks:[{id,title,planned:{start,finish}}]}; preset is a builtin ID from list_presets (default chrona-default-draft). Returns workspace and workspaceRevision for the first inline authoring command. Use validate_workspace, apply_authoring_command, workspace_revision and render_workspace for the lifecycle.

project.description: Compact task source normalized to the ordinary Project contract.

name: validate_workspace
description: Validate workspace {workspace:<relative YAML path>} and its complete preset/resource closure without writing. Returns workspaceRevision. For an edit, pass that value as apply_authoring_command.command.baseRevision; a successful command returns the next authoringResult.resultRevision.

workspace.description: A '/'-separated path relative to the workspace root. No drive, no leading '/', no '..', no backslash or colon. The file must already exist inside the workspace.

name: workspace_revision
description: Read workspace {workspace:<relative YAML path>} and return its canonical workspaceRevision without writing. Use it as an inline authoring command baseRevision; a stale rejection writes nothing. After a successful edit use authoringResult.resultRevision instead of reading a file or provoking an error.

workspace.description: A '/'-separated path relative to the workspace root. No drive, no leading '/', no '..', no backslash or colon. The file must already exist inside the workspace.

name: render_workspace
description: Render workspace {workspace:<relative YAML path>,viewport?,locale?,format?,inline?} without writing. Uses the same pinned preset resolution, Theme expressions and rendering as render-workspace, not raw Project render_draft. format is svg/png; inline image/svg/none controls the preview, default image. Returns artifact identity/length, availability and typed warnings; a rejected plan is a result, not a tool error.
